title: Enterprise Connectivity: bank-return fee
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following bank-return fee for each named contract tier. Fee per bank-confirmed returned remittance; USD decimal.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | bank-return fee | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | bank-return fee | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | bank-return fee | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | bank-return fee | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | bank-return fee | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | bank-return fee | 0 |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the bank-return fee is 0.
